Theorem
[Stokes's Theorem] ↗ UNRESOLVED:ch16:16.11 1. chB:B.21

If $M$ is an oriented smooth $n$-manifold with boundary and $\omega $ is a compactly supported smooth $(n-1)$-form on $M$, then \begin{equation} \int _M d\omega = \int _{\partial M} \omega . \tag {B.13} \end{equation}

In the statement of this theorem, $\partial M$ is understood to have the Stokes orientation, and the right-hand side is interpreted as the integral of the pullback of $\omega $ to $\partial M$. The following special case is frequently useful.
